title: Session 1 · Your first writing sample
description: Writing and spelling come first. Write your own answer below, then click Send answers to Rory. About 15 minutes. The short AI chat is optional.
objectives: Share your own ideas in complete sentences.
Save a first writing sample so Rory can plan useful spelling and writing practice.
source: Rory’s original supplementary English practice, 12 November 2026; not a textbook task.

tasks.prompt: Write 80–120 words about an enjoyable day or a small problem you solved. Real or invented is fine. Say what happened, what you did, why it mattered and what you would do next time. Use your own words. If that feels too much, write 5–6 sentences. Try it yourself before using corrections. Type below or add a clear photo of your handwriting.
tasks.title: 1. Write about one day or a small problem

tasks.prompt: List any words you were unsure how to spell. Tell Rory what felt difficult and whether you used spelling suggestions, a dictionary or other help. It is fine to say “none”. Then click Send answers to Rory.
tasks.title: 2. Tell Rory which words were tricky

tasks.prompt: Optional · Talk through the same enjoyable day or small problem as your writing. The AI asks one question at a time: what happened, what you did, why it mattered and what you would do next time. About 3 minutes. This helps organise ideas; it does not check spelling. No separate recording or written chat report is needed.

title: Session 2 · Spelling and a better draft
description: After Session 1: practise five spellings, improve your paragraph, then click Send answers to Rory. About 15 minutes. Keep your first version unchanged. The short AI chat is optional.
objectives: Practise five useful words from your own writing.
Improve a paragraph while keeping the original and revision separate.
source: Rory’s original supplementary English practice, 12 November 2026; selected targets will come from Kashi’s own saved work.

tasks.prompt: Open your Session 1 writing in another tab, or use your handwritten copy. Choose five words you were unsure how to spell, or use words from your feedback. Check each spelling in a dictionary. Look, cover, write from memory, then check. Below, list the five words and write one new sentence with each. Say which spellings you corrected. If feedback is not ready, use words you are unsure of; they may already be right.
tasks.title: 1. Practise five spellings

tasks.prompt: Write an improved version of your Session 1 paragraph below, or add a clear photo. Check capitals, full stops, word order and your five spellings. Keep your original in Session 1 unchanged. Add one sentence saying what you changed. Use your own words; an AI may explain a correction, but should not write your paragraph. Then click Send answers to Rory.
tasks.title: 2. Improve your paragraph

tasks.prompt: Optional · Talk about one sentence you want to improve from Session 1. Read it aloud or tell the AI your idea. It asks what you mean and helps you say one clearer sentence. You then write and check the spelling yourself. About 3 minutes. No separate recording or chat report is needed.
